typical_note: Official prices, checked Nov 14, 2026. Metro rides cost $2.25 to $6.75 on weekdays depending on distance.

sos.note: Police, ambulance and fire, free from any phone. For non-emergencies, call 311.

know_how.title: Tipping
know_how.text: Restaurants with table service: 15 to 20% of the bill before tax. Check the bill first, since some places add a service charge. Taxis and ride apps: about 15 to 20%. Bartenders: about $1 to $2 a drink.

know_how.title: Sales tax
know_how.text: Prices on menus and shelves don't include tax; it's added at the till. In DC, restaurant meals and drinks are taxed at 10% and most shopping at 6%. Virginia and Maryland have their own rates.

know_how.title: Cards and cash
know_how.text: Cards and phone payments work almost everywhere, including Metro gates. Some places are card only. Carry a little cash for tips and market stalls.

know_how.title: Free museums
know_how.text: The Smithsonian museums, the National Gallery of Art and the memorials are free. Air and Space and the African American History museum need free timed passes; book them before you go.

know_how.title: Security checks
know_how.text: Museums, the Capitol and the Washington Monument screen bags at the door, and lines can build. Travel light; large bags slow you down.

know_how.title: November weather
know_how.text: Cool to cold, with short days. The memorials are open around the clock and lit at night, so a walk after dark is worth it. Bring layers and a warm jacket.

know_how.title: Metro manners
know_how.text: On escalators, stand on the right and walk on the left. Let people off the train before you board.

know_how.title: Phones
know_how.text: Coverage is good across the city. A US eSIM or local SIM is usually cheaper than roaming for a week or more.

know_how_note: General customs, not rules. Tax rates from the DC Office of the Chief Financial Officer, checked Nov 14, 2026.

emergency_note: Pharmacies such as CVS and Walgreens are easy to find, and some are open late. Another 24-hour emergency room: MedStar Georgetown University Hospital, 3800 Reservoir Road NW. For a lost passport, contact your country's embassy here in Washington.
travel_notes: The Washington Monument changes color about a third of the way up: building stopped for over 20 years, and the new stone came from a different quarry.
The Mall's museums open around 10 a.m. Start with a memorial or a market and beat the lines.
From the Lincoln Memorial steps, the Reflecting Pool lines up with the Washington Monument and the Capitol dome.
